title: New pending HTML prospects get no url-text fetch; metadata generation skips all
description:
## Observed

After `process-research-now` registered 18 HTML prospects (`catalog media_type: text/html`):

urlText: eligible=0 planned=0 changes=0 failures=0
metadataGeneration: attempted=18 generated=0 skippedMissingText=18

## Expected

Eligible HTML/PDF sources are fetched for extracted text (or a clear per-ref skip reason), then metadata generation can run. Silent 0/18 eligibility with 18 metadata skips is under-delivery.

## Evidence

`.papyrus-runs/c46828-e2e/process-research-now.json` on branch `epic/e2e-ingestion`.
